data.name: Sharvansheek
data.gender_notes: Sharvansheek is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is protected by the God Sharvan or the God of Fertility and Agriculture. The name Sharvansheek carries the meaning “God's Protector” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Sharvansheek usually hope their child will grow to embody god's protector and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a child who is destined to be protected by the divine
data.etymology: Sharvansheek belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's Protector.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sharvansheek total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
